BUILT: shared-advisor-router-response converts 403/404 on the registry key into 200 {schema_version:1, firm_id, books:[], as_of:null, status:'no_registry_published', read_at}. ORDERING VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY by 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z positionally -- guard emit :182, guard 502 return :194, explicit empty :247, i.e. 53 lines AFTER the guard returns -- so a cross-firm mis-route is BLOCKED and can never be softened into a benign empty. as_of is NULL deliberately: SAT-a-4 requires the carrier resolve THE DATA'S OWN as-of at read time, and an absent registry has none; stamping read_at there would manufacture a freshness signal for something that does not exist.
